category_sets._note: Divit 2026-10-14 (competitor library extension): hubctl table with no --vs picks the set by the page's primary keyword. Sets are tried in this order; the first whose term matches the primary as a whole word (plural s/es allowed, case-insensitive) wins; no match uses general. From the set, vendors with a fact for every row are kept (those whose site ranks in the page's top 10 first, then set order) and the first 3 are used. Explicit --vs, --rows and --variant always win. New writing only: reviewed and live tables keep their stored vs, rows and variant.
